title: Baralan and Istituto Marangoni join forces on cosmetic packaging training
summary: The Italian packaging supplier is partnering with Istituto Marangoni Milano to educate the next generation of professionals in the beauty packaging industry, with the aim of bringing students closer to the real dynamics of the cosmetic packaging sector and fostering direct dialogue between academia and industry. The partnership aims to give students from Istituto Marangoni's Master's and Bachelor's programmes the opportunity to explore the relationship between creativity, innovation,... - Industry buzz
